# bitbucket_pipeline_variable (Resource)

A repository-level Bitbucket Pipelines variable. When secured = true, Bitbucket never returns the value again after creation, so Terraform keeps trusting the value in your configuration/state instead of refreshing it from the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_pipeline_variable" "db_url" {
  repository_slug = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  key             = "DB_URL"
  value           = "postgres://example"
  secured         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Variable name, as used in bitbucket-pipelines.yml.
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository this variable belongs to.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value.

### Optional

- `secured` (Boolean) If true, Bitbucket hides the value from logs and the API after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/variable_uuid".
- `variable_uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_pipeline_variable.db_url payments-api/{variable-uuid}
```
